goal: 说服朋友买性价比更高的那款

n1.speaker: 朋友 Tom
n1.line: I am going to buy the new Phone X this weekend. It is the most popular model this year!
n1.lineCn: 我这个周末要买新款 Phone X,它是今年最火的机型!

grammar.name: 最高级 the most...
grammar.note: the most popular 是 popular 的最高级,表示"最受欢迎的"。

options.text: Wait! Phone X is much more expensive than Phone A, and the difference is really small.
options.textCn: 等等!Phone X 比 Phone A 贵得多,但差别其实很小。
options.feedback: 用比较级指出价格差距,提出质疑。
随声附和,没有帮朋友理性比较。
答非所问,完全没接朋友的话题。

n2.speaker: 朋友 Tom
n2.line: Really? But Phone X has the fastest processor and the best camera on the market. Is Phone A really better?
n2.lineCn: 真的吗?可 Phone X 有市场上最快的处理器和最好的相机。Phone A 真的更好吗?

grammar.name: the + 最高级
grammar.note: the fastest, the best 是最高级形式,表示三者以上之最。

options.text: Look: Phone A is almost as fast as Phone X, but its price is 1,200 yuan lower. For most of us, A is a wiser choice.
options.textCn: 你看:Phone A 速度和 Phone X 几乎一样快,但价格便宜 1200 元。对我们大多数人来说,A 更明智。
options.feedback: 用 as...as 同级比较加数字对比,论证有力。
态度模糊,完全没有说服力。

n3.speaker: 朋友 Tom
n3.line: Hmm, but I really want the newest one. Do you think the expensive one is worth the money?
n3.lineCn: 嗯,可我真的想要最新款。你觉得贵的这款值这个价吗?

grammar.name: the newest / the expensive one
grammar.note: 形容词最高级修饰具体事物,表达"最新/最贵"。

options.text: Actually, the cheaper one has a longer battery life, which is more important to me. You should compare them carefully first.
options.textCn: 其实,便宜那款续航更久,这点对我更重要。你应该先仔细比较一下。
options.feedback: 用比较级长续航、重要性对比,给出理性建议。

options.text: Yes, it is worth it. Just buy it.
options.feedback: 盲目支持,反而可能让朋友多花冤枉钱。

n4.speaker: 朋友 Tom
n4.line: You have a point. But I still feel that Phone X looks cooler. Is the camera really the only thing that matters?
n4.lineCn: 你说得有道理。可我还是觉得 Phone X 更酷。难道相机是唯一重要的东西吗?

grammar.name: 比较级 + than
grammar.note: looks cooler 是 cool 的比较级,表达"看起来更酷"。

options.text: The camera of Phone A is even better than that of Phone X in low light. And its screen is as large as X's. Cool is not everything!
options.textCn: Phone A 的相机在暗光下甚至比 Phone X 更好,屏幕也一样大。酷不是一切!
options.feedback: 用 even better than / as large as 层层比较,论据充分。

options.text: Then buy the cooler one. Never mind the price.
options.textCn: 那就买更酷的,别管价格。
options.feedback: 放弃论证,朋友多半会冲动消费。

n5.speaker: 朋友 Tom
n5.line: I am really confused. Can you show me which one has a higher cost-performance ratio?
n5.lineCn: 我真的很纠结。你能帮我看看哪个性价比更高吗?

grammar.name: 比较级 higher
grammar.note: higher 是 high 的比较级,用于两者比较:性价比更高。

options.text: Sure. Phone A has almost the same functions but a much lower price, so its ratio is the highest. That is the smarter deal.
options.textCn: 当然。Phone A 功能几乎一样但价格低得多,所以它的性价比最高,这才是更划算的。
options.feedback: 用 the highest 最高级下结论,说服力拉满。

options.text: I have no idea. Just follow your heart.
options.textCn: 我不知道,跟着感觉走吧。
options.feedback: 没有给出任何实际对比。

n6.speaker: 朋友 Tom
n6.line: Okay, I am convinced! But is it more convenient to buy it online or in the store?
n6.lineCn: 好吧,我被说服了!不过网上买还是店里买更方便呢?

grammar.name: more convenient than
grammar.note: 多音节形容词用 more + 原级构成比较级,表示"更方便"。

options.text: Buying online is usually cheaper than buying in the store, and the delivery is faster too. Let us order it together now!
options.textCn: 网上买通常比店里买便宜,送货也更快。我们现在一起下单吧!
options.feedback: 比较级对比购物渠道,还带朋友一起下单,劝服成功!

options.text: Hmm, maybe you should buy Phone X anyway.
options.textCn: 嗯,也许你还是该买 Phone X。
options.feedback: 临阵反悔,前面的话都白说了。

success.speaker: 朋友 Tom
success.line: You are right! Phone A is the better choice. Thanks for saving me 1,200 yuan!
success.lineCn: 你说得对!Phone A 是更好的选择。谢谢你帮我省了 1200 元!

fail1.speaker: 朋友 Tom
fail1.line: Alright, maybe I will just buy Phone X. Thanks anyway!
fail1.lineCn: 好吧,也许我还是买 Phone X 吧。不管怎样,谢谢你!

fail2.speaker: 朋友 Tom
fail2.line: Wait, now I am even more confused. Let me think about it at home.
fail2.lineCn: 等等,我现在更糊涂了。我回家再想想。
